correctness.rationale: For f=r² the Kuramoto drift is exactly (3K/2)grad f. On greedy arcs, PMP costate p=λgrad f and adjoint p_dot=-(3K/2)H p force (3K+sqrt(P)/||grad f||)Hgrad f collinear with grad f. The explicit exact witness has nonzero cross product. Standard control compactness gives existence of a minimizer, so greedy is strictly nonoptimal. The real-analytic identity theorem proves open density; exact algebra verified with packaged checker.
